{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Round to 3 decimal places for reporting, but keep full precision for internal use
rounded_correlation = round(correlation, 3)

# Print the rounded value as evidence
print(rounded_correlation)"}
